title: Variance Conjecture for Log-Concave Random Vectors
exact_target: Does there exist an absolute constant $C$ such that every centered log-concave random vector $X\in\mathbb R^n$ satisfies $\operatorname{Var}(|X|^2)\leq C\lambda_X^2\mathbb E|X|^2$, where $\lambda_X^2$ is the largest eigenvalue of its covariance matrix?
